end

module fsm_3state (
    input clk, reset,
    output reg [1:0] state
);

    // State encoding
    localparam A = 2'b00, B = 2'b01, C = 2'b10;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= A; // Reset to state A
        end else begin
            case (state)
                A: state <= B; // Transition from A to B
                B: state <= C; // Transition from B to C
                C: state <= A; // Transition from C to A
                default: state <= A; // Default case (failsafe)
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

module traffic_light (
    input clk, reset,
    output reg [2:0] light
);

    reg [1:0] state;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= 2'b00;
            light <= 3'b001; // Red light
        end else begin
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin
                    state <= 2'b01;
                    light <= 3'b010; // Green light
                end
                2'b01: begin
                    state <= 2'b10;
                    light <= 3'b100; // Yellow light
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    state <= 2'b00;
                    light <= 3'b001; // Red light
                end
                default: begin
                    state <= 2'b00;
                    light <= 3'b001; // Default to Red light
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

    reg signed [7:0] base;    // Base value for computation
    reg [7:0] counter;        // Counter for iterations
    reg signed [7:0] mod;     // Modulus value

    always @(in_0 or in_1 or in_2) begin
        base = in_0;          // Initialize base from input
        counter = in_1;       // Exponent value as loop counter
        mod = in_2;           // Modulus value
        result = 1;           // Initialize result to 1

        while (counter > 0) begin
            result = result * base; // Multiply current result with base
            temp = result % mod;    // Apply modulo operation
            result = temp;          // Update result with modulo value
            counter = counter - 1;  // Decrement counter
        end
    end

    assign out = result[7:0];  // Assign the final result to output (lower 8 bits)

endmodule

module present_value (
    input [15:0] future_amount,
    input [7:0] rate,
    input [7:0] n,
    output reg [15:0] present_value
);

    // Internal registers and wires
    reg [31:0] scaled_rate; // To store (1 + rate/100) in fixed-point
    reg [31:0] power_result; // To store (1 + rate/100)^n in fixed-point
    reg [31:0] divisor; // Temporary divisor for division
    integer i;

    // Fixed-point scaling for (1 + rate/100)
    always @* begin
        scaled_rate = (100 + rate) * 65536 / 100; // Scale (1 + rate/100) to fixed-point
    end

    // Exponentiation: Compute (1 + rate/100)^n
    always @* begin
        power_result = 65536; // Start with 1 in fixed-point (1.0 = 65536)
        for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin
            power_result = (power_result * scaled_rate) >> 16; // Fixed-point multiplication
        end
    end

    // Division: Compute future_amount / (1 + rate/100)^n
    always @* begin
        divisor = power_result; // Load the computed power result
        present_value = (future_amount * 65536) / divisor; // Fixed-point division
    end

endmodule

module heat_index (
    input [7:0] temperature,   // Temperature in Celsius
    input [7:0] humidity,      // Humidity in percentage
    input signed [15:0] C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9,    // Quartic T^2*R^2
    output signed [15:0] heat_index // Heat Index in Celsius
);

    wire signed [15:0] T = $signed(temperature);   // Sign-extend temperature
    wire signed [15:0] R = $signed(humidity);      // Sign-extend humidity

    wire signed [31:0] T_sq = T * T;               // T^2
    wire signed [31:0] R_sq = R * R;               // R^2
    wire signed [31:0] T_R = T * R;                // T*R
    wire signed [31:0] T_sq_R = T_sq * R;          // T^2*R
    wire signed [31:0] T_R_sq = T * R_sq;          // T*R^2
    wire signed [31:0] T_sq_R_sq = T_sq * R_sq;    // T^2*R^2

    wire signed [31:0] term1 = C1 * T;             // C1*T
    wire signed [31:0] term2 = C2 * R;             // C2*R
    wire signed [31:0] term3 = C3 * T_sq;          // C3*T^2
    wire signed [31:0] term4 = C4 * R_sq;          // C4*R^2
    wire signed [31:0] term5 = C5 * T_R;           // C5*T*R
    wire signed [31:0] term6 = C6 * T_sq_R;        // C6*T^2*R
    wire signed [31:0] term7 = C7 * T_R_sq;        // C7*T*R^2
    wire signed [31:0] term8 = C8 * T_sq_R_sq;     // C8*T^2*R^2
    wire signed [31:0] term9 = C9;                 // C9

    wire signed [31:0] heat_index_full = term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9;

    assign heat_index = heat_index_full[15:0];     // Truncate to 16 bits

endmodule

module heat_index (
    input [7:0] temperature,   // Temperature in Celsius
    input [7:0] humidity,      // Humidity in percentage
    input signed [15:0] C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9,    // Quartic T^2*R^2
    output signed [15:0] heat_index // Heat Index in Celsius
);

    wire signed [15:0] T = $signed(temperature); // Convert temperature to signed
    wire signed [15:0] R = $signed(humidity);    // Convert humidity to signed
    
    wire signed [31:0] TR = T * R;               // T * R
    wire signed [31:0] T2 = T * T;               // T^2
    wire signed [31:0] R2 = R * R;               // R^2
    wire signed [31:0] T2R = T2 * R;             // T^2 * R
    wire signed [31:0] TR2 = T * R2;             // T * R^2
    wire signed [31:0] T2R2 = T2 * R2;           // T^2 * R^2

    wire signed [31:0] term1 = C1 * T;           // C1 * T
    wire signed [31:0] term2 = C2 * R;           // C2 * R
    wire signed [31:0] term3 = C3 * TR;          // C3 * T * R
    wire signed [31:0] term4 = C4 * T2;          // C4 * T^2
    wire signed [31:0] term5 = C5 * R2;          // C5 * R^2
    wire signed [31:0] term6 = C6 * T2R;         // C6 * T^2 * R
    wire signed [31:0] term7 = C7 * TR2;         // C7 * T * R^2
    wire signed [31:0] term8 = C8 * T2R2;        // C8 * T^2 * R^2
    wire signed [31:0] term9 = C9;               // C9 (constant term)

    wire signed [31:0] sum = term1 + term2 + term3 + term4 + term5 + term6 + term7 + term8 + term9;

    assign heat_index = sum[15:0];               // Truncate to 16 bits for output

endmodule
